purpose: Teach: 淡い/申す/かけがえ/えらく/おぼえ/おろか/無邪気/あきれ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、淡いピンクのシャツ買ったろ?
lines.en: Riku, you actually bought that pale pink shirt, didn't you?
lines.style: Teasing, knowingly curious. Slight lilt upward at the end—she's caught him in something. Quick, playful delivery. Not quite innocent.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ちゃんと「申す」って言葉、知ってるか、桜
lines.en: Do you even know what the word 'mōsu' means, Sakura?
lines.style: Wry deflection. Slight edge beneath the surface—he's sidestepping her jab with a question of his own. Dry, measured pace. A small, self-aware smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前との時間は、かけがえのない時間だな
lines.en: Time with you—it's irreplaceable, you know?
lines.style: Sincere underneath the surface. Soft, almost vulnerable opening. Held breath before 'irreplaceable.' Quiet conviction, not looking directly at him. Trailing off slightly, like she's surprised at herself for saying it aloud.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、テスト点、えらく上がったな、桜
lines.en: Your test scores have gone up quite a bit, haven't they, Sakura?
lines.style: Genuine warmth with understated praise. Even delivery, no condescension. A small nod in the voice—noticing something real without making a show of it. Steady eye contact level.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、英単語をしっかりおぼえろよ
lines.en: Make sure you actually memorize your English vocabulary, okay?
lines.style: Pragmatic, affectionate firmness. Not scolding—more the tone of someone who believes she can do better and is saying it plainly. Light punch of emphasis on 'actually.' Brief and direct.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、おろかな喧嘩はもうやめろよ、桜
lines.en: Stop getting into stupid fights, alright, Sakura?
lines.style: Tired patience with a thread of real concern underneath. Not angry, but exasperated—like he's seen this before and doesn't want to see it again. Slight lean forward in the voice. Ends with quiet certainty, not a question.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前の無邪気な笑顔、いいよな
lines.en: That innocent smile of yours—it gets me, you know?
lines.style: Soft, almost wistful admission. Small hesitation before committing to the compliment. Warm but slightly nervous—this is real territory. Ends gently, like he's said more than he meant to.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、テストの結果にあきれてんな、桜
lines.en: You're pretty shocked by how you did on the test, aren't you?
lines.style: Dry wit with an underlying softness. Slight smirk in the delivery. Observant—he's noticed her reaction before she's named it. Not mocking, but gently calling her out. Measured, almost amused pace.
